title: Markovian Circuit Tracing: Ground-Truth Tests of Transformer State Abstractions
abstract: arXiv:2605.20824v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability needs tests that separate accessible information from a causally useful internal abstraction. We introduce Markovian Circuit Tracing (MCT), a controlled benchmark for testing whether transformer activations support a compact state abstraction with recoverable transition structure. We train small causal transformers on sequences from four-state hidden Markov models. The experiment fixes the latent transition law and varies emission observability. The canonical artifact contains 15 runs across five fixed seeds. Every model reaches validation loss within 0.02 nats per token of the exact Bayes predictor. Under easy observability, held-out mean rowwise Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence from the true transition matrix is 0.114. The easy shuffled control gives 0.379. Under medium observability, recovered transition KL is 0.221. The medium shuffled control gives 0.355. Recovery collapses to control performance und

translated_title: 马尔可夫电路追踪：Transformer状态抽象的真值测试
translated_abstract: 机制可解释性需要能够将可获取的信息与因果有效的内部抽象区分开的测试。我们提出了马尔可夫电路追踪（MCT），这是一个受控基准，用于检验Transformer的激活是否支持一种具有可恢复转移结构的紧凑状态抽象。我们在由四状态隐马尔可夫模型生成的序列上训练小型因果Transformer。实验固定了潜在的转移规律，仅改变发射符号的可观测性。规范的实验产物包含五个固定随机种子下的15次运行。所有模型的验证损失均达到与精确贝叶斯预测器相差每token不超过0.02奈特的水平。在高（容易）可观测性条件下，留出数据上相对于真实转移矩阵的平均逐行KL散度为0.114，而容易条件下的打乱对照组为0.379；在中等可观测性条件下，恢复出的转移矩阵KL散度为0.221，而中等条件下的打乱对照组为0.355。在更低可观测性下，恢复效果坍缩至对照水平……（原文摘要不完整）
tldr: 提出马尔可夫电路追踪（MCT）这一受控基准，通过在四状态隐马尔可夫模型序列上训练小型Transformer并系统改变可观测性，证明其激活在较高可观测性条件下能够恢复出具有真实转移结构的紧凑状态抽象，而在可观测性降低时恢复效果坍缩至对照水平。
en_tdlr: We introduce Markovian Circuit Tracing (MCT), a controlled benchmark demonstrating that transformer activations trained on four-state hidden Markov model sequences recover compact state abstractions with the true transition structure under easy and medium observability, while recovery collapses to control performance as observability decreases.
